title: Tôi đã đặt một phòng khác.
pronunciation: Toi da dat mot phong khac
summary: For telling the front desk the room assigned does not match the room you booked.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: The booking screen, room type, bed setup, or confirmation email is the proof.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Say the phrase before unpacking. Then show the booking so the desk can compare the room type.

phrases.vietnamese: Tôi đã đặt một phòng khác.
phrases.pronunciation: Toi da dat mot phong khac

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Tôi đã đặt means I booked; một phòng khác means a different room.

breakdown.vietnamese: Tôi đã đặt một phòng khác.

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Not the room I booked, booking wrong, and booked online phrases help prove the mismatch.

phrases.vietnamese: Đây không phải là phòng tôi đã đặt
phrases.english: This is not the room I booked
phrases.pronunciation: Day khong phai la phong toi da dat

phrases.vietnamese: Tôi nghĩ có vấn đề với việc đặt phòng của tôi.
phrases.english: I think there is a problem with my booking.
phrases.pronunciation: Toi nghi co van de voi viec dat phong cua toi

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good at hotel desks, guesthouses, homestays, and serviced apartments when the assigned room feels wrong.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Stay specific: room type, bed count, window, floor, or booking photo. That is easier to fix than a long complaint.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Change rooms, see the room first, nearby rooms, two beds, and room refund phrases cover the next front-desk move.

phrases.english: Can I have a room with two beds?
phrases.pronunciation: Toi co the dat mot phong co hai giuong duoc khong

phrases.vietnamese: Tôi có thể được hoàn lại tiền phòng không?

phrases.pronunciation: Toi co the duoc hoan lai tien phong khong
